name: signal-chain-renderer
description: Renderer is loaded by Electron as browser ES modules (<script type="module">), not by Node. This file exists so the Node test runner (test/*.test.mjs) resolves renderer/**/*.js as ES modules instead of CommonJS. The app itself does not read it, and the CommonJS main process (main.js/preload.js in the repo root) is unaffected because this package.json only governs the renderer/ subtree.
